title: Infra Delivery Lead
description:
Service Delivery Ownership 
 - Own end-to-end delivery of L1.5 and L2 infrastructure operations. 
 - Lead the Infra Command Center (L1.5) and the Hosting, Connectivity, DBA and Data Tribe pods. 
 - Act as single point of contact for the client infrastructure leadership. 
 - Run daily stand-ups and weekly service reviews with tower leads. 
 - Drive service improvement plans to closure. SLA, Reporting and Governance 
 - Track response and resolution SLAs across all infra towers. 
 - Publish weekly and monthly SLA, KPI and backlog reports. 
 - Present service performance at monthly and quarterly governance reviews. 
 - Review monthly capacity, utilisation and performance reports for servers and databases. 
 - Maintain the RAID log for infrastructure services. 
 - Enforce ServiceNow ticket hygiene, CMDB accuracy and closure quality. 
 Incident, Escalation and MIM 
 - Attend MIM bridge calls for P1/P2 infrastructure and data platform incidents. 
 - Own client and internal escalations through to closure. 
 - Drive RCA, problem management and defect elimination plans. 
 - Coordinate with SecOps towers, OEM and hardware vendors, telecom carriers and client L3 teams. 
 - Drive repeat-incident reduction and alert tuning with the Command Center. 
 Change, Patching and Availability 
 - Govern change requests and maintenance windows across all infra towers. 
 - Track monthly OS, VMware, database and zero-day patch compliance. 
 - Oversee backup success, restore tests and DR / BCP drills. 
 - Oversee server, database and network builds and decommissions. 
 - Track platform software licences and expiry dates. 
 
 Commercials and Contract 
 - Own monthly invoicing inputs and reconciliation for infrastructure services. 
 - Track deliverables against SOW scope and contractual obligations. 
 - Raise and manage change requests for scope changes. 
 - Lead contractual reviews, including service credits and penalties. Resourcing and People 
 - Plan capacity, shift rosters and 24x7 on-call coverage. 
 - Hire, onboard and retain engineers; manage backfills and leave cover. 
 - Maintain the skill matrix and cross-skilling plan across pods. 
 - Run performance reviews, coaching and career plans for the team. 
 Compliance and Continual Improvement 
 - Ensure adherence to client infrastructure standards and security policies. 
 - Track OS hardening, system agent and audit-log compliance. - Support internal and external audits with evidence. 
 - Drive automation of routine tasks, patching and deployments. 
 - Keep SOPs, runbooks and knowledge-base articles current. 
 - Lead onboarding and transition of new infrastructure services. Tools/Technology - knowhow 
 - AWS (EC2, S3, ELB, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, IAM) 
 - Microsoft Azure 
 - Windows Server and Linux / Unix 
 - Cisco routers, switches and WLAN controllers 
 - Firewalls load balancers 
 - Cisco Call Manager / PBX 
 - Databases (Oracle, MS SQL, Cloud databases) 
 - Datadog 
 - PagerDuty 
 - ServiceNow (ITSM, CMDB, reporting and dashboards) 
 - Tableau, Power BI / Excel for service reporting (good to have) 
 - Jira and Confluence (good to have) Processes and Frameworks 
 - ITIL service management: incident, problem, change, request 
 - Disaster recovery and business continuity 
 - Automation and scripting: PowerShell, Bash, Python (good to have) 
 - Infrastructure as code: Terraform (good to have) Experience 
 - 12+ years in IT infrastructure operations 
 - 5+ years as delivery lead in a managed services setup 
 - Led 24x7 multi-tower infrastructure operations for a global enterprise 
 - Managed onshore and offshore teams of 20+ engineers 
 - Exposure to AWS, Azure, Windows, Linux, , Oracle, SQL Server and Datadog 
 - Oversight of data platform operations: Airflow, Talend, Snowflake, Tableau and Power BI 
 - SLA management, invoicing and contract reviews in an MSP model 
 - MIM participation and senior stakeholder escalation handling 
 - Service transition from an incumbent provider (good to have) 
 - Clear written and spoken English; confident with senior leadership Certifications - Good to have 
 - ITIL 4 Foundation 
 - AWS Solutions Architect - Associate or Microsoft AZ-104 (good to have) 
 - CCNA / CCNP or Oracle OCP (good to have)
